customSections.label: What Hampton Families Should Know
customSections.content: Hampton’s elementary, high school, and year-end schedules do not always follow the same pattern.

groups.label: Elementary families
items: September 18 and February 22 are elementary-only teacher planning and professional development days. Only elementary students are off on these two dates.

groups.label: January schedule
items: Students return from Winter Break on Tuesday, January 5, 2027.
High school exams run January 19–22. Students do not report January 25–26, and the second semester begins January 27.

groups.label: End of school
items: May 28 is an Early Close for students and staff divisionwide, two hours before regular dismissal.
Elementary and middle schools have early release June 4 and June 7–9. High schools follow their exam schedule on those dates.
June 9 is the final student day.

groups.label: Graduation
items: Phoebus High School graduation is June 10 at 7:00 p.m.
Kecoughtan High School graduation is June 11 at 7:00 p.m.
Bethel High School graduation is June 12 at 9:00 a.m.
Hampton High School graduation is June 12 at 1:30 p.m.

groups.label: Weather make-up days
items: HCS has one banked student instructional day for inclement weather. Additional missed days are made up at the superintendent’s discretion.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Hampton City Schools start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Hampton City Schools starts school on Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hampton City Schools Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 5 through Friday, April 9, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Hampton high school exam dates in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The January high school exam schedule runs January 19–22, 2027. High schools also follow the exam schedule on June 4 and June 7–9.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Hampton high school graduations in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists high school graduations on June 10–12, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Which days are elementary-only no-school days in Hampton City Schools?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary students do not report on September 18, 2026, or February 22, 2027, for teacher planning and professional development. Only elementary students are off on these two dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Hampton City Schools have a fall break?
calendarFaqs.a: Hampton City Schools does not list a traditional fall break on the 2026–27 calendar. The calendar does include teacher workdays, a conference day, and holidays when students do not report.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Hampton City Schools students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return from Winter Break on Tuesday, January 5, 2027, after a teacher work day on Monday, January 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hampton City Schools winter break 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Hampton City Schools Winter Break runs from Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return on Tuesday, January 5, 2027.
